title: MFEM printer (C++ NonlinearFormIntegrator + Voigt + MPI)
objective: Add a second code generator alongside the Taichi printer that emits a C++ MFEM `NonlinearFormIntegrator` subclass from the same Element IR. Handles Voigt convention conversion and MPI-parallel execution out of the box.
scope: Add `mechdsl.codegen.mfem_printer` module mirroring the shape of `taichi_printer`.
Consumes the same `ArtifactBundle`; emits a standalone `.cpp` file that integrates the residual and tangent for the problem.
Map the MVP unscaled tensorial Voigt ordering to MFEM's engineering Voigt.
Include a hand-rolled CMakeLists.txt template for the generated app.
implementation_steps: Read MFEM's `NonlinearFormIntegrator` API docs to understand the interface shape.
Design the module layout: emit_preamble, emit_constants, emit_constitutive, emit_force_integrator, emit_tangent_integrator, emit_main.
Implement the Voigt conversion helper (6-index map from tensorial to engineering).
Unit-test at the source-text level: emission produces parseable C++ that references the right MFEM types.
Do NOT attempt to compile the emitted C++ in this task — P8-3 covers that.
acceptance_criteria: MFEM source emission produces a syntactically valid C++ file (parse-check via clang-format or similar).
Voigt round-trip test: tensorial → MFEM engineering → tensorial preserves the tensor.
risks: No local MFEM install makes it hard to verify the emitted code. Mitigation: defer compile-verification to P8-3 which can run in a CI container with MFEM pre-installed, or use libclang to parse the emitted C++.
completion_notes: Added mechdsl.codegen.mfem_printer with emit(), emit_cmakelists(), and Voigt conversion helpers (tensorial <-> engineering).

Emits a self-contained .cpp with mfem::ParNonlinearForm driver + MechDSLSaintVenantKirchhoff integrator (subclass of mfem::NonlinearFormIntegrator) that implements AssembleElementVector and AssembleElementGrad for Hex8 + SVK.
Guards: NotImplementedError for non-Hex8 element types and DynamicsMode.EXPLICIT; ValueError for non-SVK materials (post-MVP).
CMakeLists.txt template shipped under mfem_template/ with find_package(MFEM REQUIRED), target_link_libraries mfem + MPI::MPI_CXX, and ${MFEM_INCLUDE_DIRS}.
Parse check uses clang-format --style=LLVM with an idempotence test, falling back to structural regex checks; clang-format --Werror was rejected because it treats cosmetic layout as errors.

Gate B attempt 1 FAILED (commit a5c14f3) on critical C++ scoping bug (out-of-scope k in elmat write) + wrong tangent (dropped shear Voigt rows/cols) + missing P8-3 deferral markers + naming divergence.

Gate B fix at commit bdfbe1a (attempt 2 APPROVED): rewrote emit_tangent_integrator to emit 6xndof B-matrix in engineering Voigt, build full 6x6 C_eng (lambda+2mu diagonals, lambda off-diagonals, mu on shear diagonals 3/4/5), compute CB = C_eng.B, then flat (p,r) accumulation — all loops close before the write. Added P8-3 deferral NOTE comments for omitted geometric tangent term, skeletal ess_bdr BC, and zero-RHS Newton driver. Renamed to MechDSLSaintVenantKirchhoff to match MOOSE convention.

Tests: 11/11 passed (3 acceptance + 3 failure-route + 2 determinism + 3 new: tangent Voigt-structure check, deferral-marker check, class-name check). Fast suite: 1238 passed / 1 failed (pre-existing P6-T5 tripwire on P8-3 stub) / 1 skipped / 59 deselected.

P8-3 carry-forwards: (1) emitted tangent is the small-strain material contribution only — for large-strain SVK, P8-3 may need to add the geometric (initial-stress) term for quadratic Newton convergence; (2) ess_bdr still pins every boundary to zero — P8-3 must wire real BC tags before compile+solve validation; (3) Newton driver uses correctly-sized zero RHS but no load stepping — P8-3 should add ramped load or tension BC.
